remarks: New Listing! First time on the market in 50 years! Bonnie Brook Road is the kind of neighborhood where the quiet is noticeable. It's a place where you can actually use the street for a long walk or a bike ride without worrying about traffic, trains, or highway noise. Precisely why the current owners have stayed so long and will have a hard time saying goodbye to this home.  35 Bonnie Brook Road sits on a completely level 1.08-acre lot-all usable land with no wetlands. It's a practical, traditional colonial home serviced by natural gas and city water, and equipped with a whole-house generator for reliability.  The main level is spacious and features an open floor plan complete with a dedicated and large home office, which the town records as a fourth bedroom. Upstairs are three large bedrooms with plenty of closet space and two updated full baths. The large basement is ready to be finished if additional room is desired.  Life at 35 Bonnie Brook is lived in the transitions between indoors and out. Start the day on the front porch overlooking the lovely front lawn with mature trees, move to the screened-in porch for a mid-day escape from the sun, and end the evening on the lovely deck. The in-ground pool is surrounded by a level lawn that also features an irrigation system.   This is a place where the air feels clearer and the rhythm of the day belongs entirely to you.
